agencyName: Arkansas Board of Electrical Examiners (Arkansas Department of Labor and Licensing)
authorityRationale: The literal administrative rules text (17 CAR Part 210) governing the Arkansas Board of Electrical Examiners, hosted directly by the Arkansas Department of Labor and Licensing. Contains the codified license-class definitions, examination/licensure qualification requirements (including the explicit journeyman reciprocity conditions at 17 CAR 210-404(e)(2)), and the full fee schedule (210-403, 210-504, 210-508).
reliabilityRationale: Primary regulatory text itself, not a summary or third-party application page — the highest reliability class, matching the Colorado regulation-text precedent (colorado-electrical-board-regulation).
